# Coding Coach

> > Coding Coach is a free, open-source mentorship platform connecting developers worldwide for career guidance, skill development, and interview preparation.

Coding Coach provides a community-driven mentorship network founded by Emma Wedekind and Crysfel Villa, offering mock interview practice, mentorship matching, and educational content focused on JavaScript, React, Node.js, and web development. The platform emphasizes peer learning, open-source contribution, and career advancement for developers at all levels.

## Key Topics

- Mentorship Platform
- Interview Preparation
- Mock Job Openings
- JavaScript
- React
- Node.js
- Career Development
- Mentor Matching
- Web Development
- Open Source
- Frontend Development
- Backend Development
- Job Application Training
- API Integration
- Developer Community

## Core Platform

- [Home](https://codingcoach.io): Coding Coach homepage connecting developers with mentors worldwide
- [About](https://codingcoach.io/about): Meet the Coding Coach team including Emma Wedekind and Crysfel Villa
- [Mentorship Guidelines](https://codingcoach.io/guidelines/mentorship-guidelines): Guidelines for mentors and mentees on the Coding Coach platform

## Interview Preparation & Mock Openings

- [Mock Openings](https://codingcoach.io/mock-openings): Practice job interviews with mock React and Node.js developer openings
- [Senior Front-end Developer, React Focus](https://codingcoach.io/mock-openings/senior-frontend-developer-react-focus): Mock React senior frontend developer interview with Redux and JavaScript

## Blog & Educational Content

- [Blog](https://codingcoach.io/blog): Community articles and tutorials on mentorship, JavaScript, and web dev
- [Leveling up your JavaScript skills](https://codingcoach.io/blog/leveling-up-your-javascript-skills): Crysfel Villa's guide to JavaScript fundamentals and skill development
- [What's the difference between == and ===?](https://codingcoach.io/blog/whats-the-difference-between-double-and-triple-equals): Crysfel Villa explains JavaScript equality operators and type coercion
- [Instagram Feed API](https://codingcoach.io/blog/netlify-serverless-function-instagram-api): Cristian Echeverria's tutorial on Netlify Functions and Instagram API
- [Diary Of A Coding Coach (Pt. 2)](https://codingcoach.io/blog/diary-of-a-coding-coach-pt-2): Emma Wedekind's insights on open-source mentorship platform development
- [Coding for fun](https://codingcoach.io/blog/coding-for-fun): Rodrigo Juarez on open-source contribution and community development
- [Welcome to the new blog](https://codingcoach.io/blog/welcome-to-the-new-blog): Crysfel Villa introduces new Gatsby blog and community contribution guide
